$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for cross-LLM agent routing.
The agent ROSTER and all PROMPT LOGIC live in .claude/agents/*.md and are never
duplicated. This file adds only what those .md files cannot express: the role
tier per agent, and the model each tool should use per tier.
Run `node scripts/sync-agent-routing.mjs` after editing this file. By default
it only CREATES shims that are missing — it never overwrites an existing
agent shim. Pass --force to re-sync (overwrite drifted shims + prune orphans)
and regenerate the AGENTS.md routing matrix. Pass --check for a read-only CI
TO ADD A NEW LLM TOOL: add one entry under `tools`. If its agent files are
'YAML-frontmatter markdown' or 'TOML with an instructions blob', just set
`emit` to the existing generic format ("frontmatter-md" or "toml") plus a
model per tier — every tool sharing a format renders the exact same
instructions, only metadata (model, reasoning effort, description, outDir,
fileSuffix) differs. Only truly new output shapes need a new emitter

claude.$comment: Models are read verbatim from each .claude/agents/<name>.md `model:` key. This tool is authoritative and is never generated or modified.

copilot.label: Copilot CLI
copilot.modelCaveat: GitHub documents `model` as a custom-agent frontmatter property but documents its model-selection effect only for VS Code, JetBrains, Eclipse and Xcode — not the CLI. Treated as declarative intent. The confirmed CLI mechanism is session-level: --model=MODEL, COPILOT_MODEL, or /model.
